# Native Cloak fixture data

These committed files are synthetic test data, not publisher captures or production data. The former Python benchmark and soak runners have been retired. The isolated Go fixture gate is maintained in `go-tools/cloakfixture` and `go-tools/cmd/cloak-fixture`; it uses owned test resources and does not contact real sites or providers. Historical experiments are documented separately in [the native worker record](../../../docs/go-cloak-native-worker.md).
